holdout_card.fact_statement: Norina Tangaro-Casingal was appointed as a COMELEC commissioner ahead of the 2025 Philippine general election.
holdout_card.source_span: President Marcos appointed Norina Tangaro-Casingal, erstwhile director of the Commission on Elections law department as commissioner on February 10, 2025
